'''Level 1325''' was a level located on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] city [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was here where [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] met with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], as a result of being framed for a crime.<ref name="Orders" />
